rules.statement: A District Court is not the proper forum to adjudicate on the validity of a determination made by the Land Commissioner that a particular land which is sought to be acquired by him is of the description contained in section 3 (1) of the Land Redemption Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: "Having regard to the limited and special jurisdiction of a District Court in land acquisition proceedings under the Land Acquisition Act, a District Court is not the proper forum to adjudicate on the validity of a determination made by the Land Commissioner that a particular land which is sought to be acquired by him is of the description contained in section 3 (1) of the Land Redemption Ordinance."
